title: SIP account additions surge to 6-month high of 1.3 million in August
text: SIP account additions surge to 6-month high of 1.3 million in August. Market rebound and attractive smallcap and midcap returns, monthly net SIP additions hit a six-month high of 1.3 million, pushing total monthly contributions to a record ₹32,297 crore
